title: A café order that can be cancelled
prompt: Draw a Mermaid stateDiagram-v2 for a café coffee order. An order is placed, paid, queued, brewed and collected, and it can be cancelled at any point before it is collected. Money goes back only if it was taken. Label every transition with exactly one of these events: pay, queue, start, finish, collect, cancel, refund.
groundTruth: The diagram parsed into a transition table and run against fixed event sequences: the happy path, and a cancel after placing, paying, queueing, brewing and collecting. The start is the state [*] points to or, since the prompt never asks for [*], the one state nothing points into.

checks.label: Renders, labels valid
checks.how: Mermaid draws it, every transition has exactly one of the seven events, and no event leads two ways.

checks.label: Happy path
checks.how: pay, queue, start, finish, collect runs from the start to an end.

checks.label: No refund if unpaid
checks.how: Cancelling straight after placing can never reach refund.

checks.label: Refund if paid
checks.how: Cancelling once paid, queued, brewing or ready cannot end without refund.

checks.label: No cancel after collect
checks.how: cancel is not accepted once the order is collected.

harder: Add a partial refund once brewing has started, so what goes back depends on where the cancel came from.

saturated.why: DeepSeek 4.1 Flash got the refund logic right in all three runs on 2026-09-22, and Pareto 26.10 Preview did it on the first render in all three on 2026-10-02.
